name: HydroPulse v2.0.0 Release
notes:
Major HydroPulse v2.0.0 Release:
- Top-positioned Start & Stop controls (no scrolling, eliminates back button risk)
- Hands-Free Voice Commands: wet-hand operation listening for 'start', 'stop', 'pause', 'resume', 'up 5', 'down 5'
- 1-to-52 Speed Notches: Endless Pools digital click scale from slowest (1) to fastest (52)
- Independent per-phone workout memory for family members
- In-app native auto-update system with live download progress
- Zero neon, simplistic water theme tailored for poolside viewing
